svg.data-weight: 13 lb (5.9 kg) with no power supply and no fan module; 16.1 lb (7.3 kg) with one power supply and two fan modules
svg.data-depth-no-psu: 416.1 mm (16.38 in) with no power supply or uplink module (Table 10)
svg.data-depth-with-uplink: 457.3 mm (18 in, 45.73 cm) with a power supply and an uplink module (Table 10)
svg.data-throughput: 369 Mpps wire speed for the 48-port models (datasheet)
svg.data-airflow-cfm: fan 22 CFM, each power supply 7.5 CFM; 59 CFM total with two supplies (datasheet)
svg.data-psu-redundancy: N+0 or N+N; up to two supplies, one is enough for the chassis
svg.data-acoustic-noise: 37.8 dBA AC AFO, 38.9 dBA AC AFI, 39.7 dBA DC AFO and DC AFI (datasheet Table 3, ISO 7779 at 23 C)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 45 C (32 to 113 F) for AFO models; 0 to 35 C for AFI models
svg.data-humidity: 10 to 85 percent noncondensing operating; 0 to 95 percent non-operating
svg.data-altitude: up to 3049 m operating (10,000 ft); 4877 m non-operating
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 members; the four rear QSFP+ ports are Virtual Chassis ports by default
svg.data-macsec: IEEE 802.1AE on all Gigabit Ethernet and 10 Gigabit Ethernet ports
svg.data-uplink-module: one slot; 4-port 1/10 GbE SFP+ EX-UM-4X4SFP (not part of the shipping configuration)
svg.data-optics-qsfp: 40GbE QSFP+ SR (multimode) and DAC direct-attach copper (datasheet, Supported Optics)
svg.data-console: mini-USB on the front, RJ-45 CON2 on the rear
svg.data-oob: MGMT RJ-45 with link activity and status lamps (rear)
svg.data-lcd: 2 lines of 16 characters with Menu and Enter buttons
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the rear
